title: Kestrel and the Summer
author: Ivo Vane
blurb: Casper Amberdale, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
